title: Extracting Training Data from Diffusion Language Models via Infilling
abstract: arXiv:2605.24173v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Memorization in large language models has been studied almost exclusively through prefix-conditioned extraction, a natural choice for autoregressive models. However, diffusion language models (DLMs) can denoise masked tokens at arbitrary positions. Thus, prefix-only probing reveals only one facet of memorization in DLMs and significantly underestimates the risk of training-data extraction. In order to realistically model extractability of training data in DLMs, we introduce infilling extraction, a data-extraction protocol parameterized by an arbitrary binary mask that subsumes prefix-only probing and accounts for the bidirectional inductive bias of DLMs. Instantiating it on LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B across five extraction modes, three training pipelines, and three corpora covering verbatim and partial leakage, we find that mask geometry governs extractability: edge-conditioned masks extract up to three times more verbatim sequences

translated_title: 通过填充从扩散语言模型中提取训练数据
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型中的记忆化问题几乎一直仅通过前缀条件提取来研究，这是自回归模型的一种自然选择。然而，扩散语言模型可以在任意位置对被掩码的标记进行去噪。因此，仅使用前缀探测只能揭示扩散语言模型中记忆化的一个侧面，并显著低估了训练数据提取的风险。为了更真实地建模扩散语言模型中训练数据的可提取性，我们引入了填充提取，这是一种由任意二进制掩码参数化的数据提取协议，它涵盖了仅前缀探测方法，并考虑了扩散语言模型的双向归纳偏置。我们在LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B上实例化该方法，涵盖五种提取模式、三种训练流程和三个语料库，包括逐字泄露和部分泄露的情况。我们发现掩码的几何结构决定了可提取性：边缘条件掩码提取的逐字序列最多可达三倍。
tldr: 该论文提出“填充提取”协议，利用任意二进制掩码全面评估扩散语言模型的训练数据泄露风险，发现传统的前缀探测方法会显著低估记忆化风险，而边缘条件掩码可提取多达三倍的逐字训练序列。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "infilling extraction," a mask-parameterized data-extraction protocol that accounts for the bidirectional nature of diffusion language models, showing that prefix-only probing significantly underestimates training-data extraction risks, with edge-conditioned masks extracting up to three times more verbatim sequences.
